note: Exact extension of the multiplicity argument. T^6 leaves both coordinates fixed mod 6 and cycles all five nonvertical slopes mod 5. On sign pairs it partitions the 240 marks into 48 five-element orbits, each meeting the act line once. Consequently orbit-constant labels have exactly the fivefold histogram. Constancy of a physical label at a fixed x requires more than joint T transport: an explicit positive T-covariant observable has unequal rates on each of the 240 fixed-column comparisons at x=13/100 yet equal rates on all transported columns. The changed-column control exits 1. This distinguishes a structural counting result from the separate finite tests of the actual Yukawas. I did not rerun the 180 matrix cases or the high-precision rate census; the model observable is used only to test the logical implication.
